steps.text: Talk to the High Priest in Sophanem.
choices: Is there any way into Menaphos from below?

steps.text: Talk to Jex in the building in north east Sophanem.
Go down the ladder east of Jex.
Be careful of traps, and follow the path to the south west ladder. Disarm traps where the path breaks, and use protection prayers against the monsters.
Follow the path along, and search Kaleef's corpse there.
Talk to Maisa on the west side of the chasm.
Talk to Osman in Al Kharid.
choices: I want to talk to you about Sophanem.
It could drive a wedge between the Menaphite cities.

steps.text: Talk to Osman north of Sophanem.
choices: I know of a secret entrance to the north.

steps.text: Prepare to fight a level 191 Giant Scarab. Go down the ladder east of Jex.
Be careful of traps, and follow the path to the south west ladder. Disarm traps where the path breaks, and use protection prayers against the monsters.
Kill the Giant Scarab near the chasm. It can extinguish your light source and poison you, so be careful. Pray melee if you are meleeing it, range if you are attacking it from a distance.
Talk to Osman in the chasm.
Report back to the High Priest in Sophanem.
